newsitem.title: USA: API says U.S. crude stocks fell in week.
newsitem.headline: API says U.S. crude stocks fell in week.

text.p: U.S. crude oil stocks held in primary storage fell 3.42 million barrels in the week ended Jan 17 to 286.04 million barrels from 289.46 million barrels the prior week, the American Petroleum Institute (API) said Tuesday.
API said that crude stocks excluding PADD 5 (Petroleum Administration for Defense District) fell 2.95 million barrels in the week to 222.71 million barrels.
Distillate stocks fell 2.95 million barrels to 122.50 million from 125.45 million the previous week.
API said PADD 1 distillate stocks fell 988,000 barrels to 45.80 million barrels.
API said gasoline production rose 145,000 barrels in the week to 7.38 million bpd from 7.23 million.
Gasoline stocks rose 3.03 million barrels in the week to 199.45 million barrels from 196.42 million barrels.
Percent of stocks capacity fell to 89.9 percent from 90.7 percent.
API said reformulated gasoline stocks (RFG) fell 275,000 barrels to 38.54 million barrels from 38.82 million barrels in the previous week.
API said crude runs to processing units fell to 13.63 million barrels from 13.77 million barrels.
Residual fuel stocks in the latest week rose to 44.07 million barrels from 43.63 million in the previous week.
Crude oil imports fell to 7.02 million barrels per day from 7.65 million, API said.
